            m = 0

                    b[i] = m

The `IndexError` comes from deleting entries from `blocks`/`num_blocks` while iterating over `rep_blocks` without deleting from `rep_blocks` at the same time. That leaves the lists out of sync, so later deletions use an index that’s no longer valid. I’ll change the logic to collect indices to remove during the scan, and then delete from all three lists in reverse order after the loop.
